total_model.summary: Model projects 46.6 total points (MIA 21, DET 26). Biggest factors: Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 1.1), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (raises total 0.9), Combined defense EPA allowed/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
